name: Girl's Blossom Project ~Uso no You na Honto no Koi~
original_name: Girl's Blossom Project〜嘘のようなホントの恋〜
source:
BanG Dream! Girls Band Project 2022 April's Fools game.

Uehara Himari is a normal high school girl attending Garupa Private Academy.
At this academy, there is a cherry blossom tree which blooms once every ten years.
They say that if you wish for happiness together with someone special
to you under that tree, your wish will surely come true.

Himari searches for her destined partner at this academy.

"This is a very important choice to me.
This moment comes only once in ten years.
The one I want to spend it with is..."

[From Official site]
translation:
班格梦想！女子乐队计划2022年4月的愚人节游戏。

上原希玛里是私立加鲁帕学园的一名普通女高中生。
这所学园里有一棵樱花树，每十年开花一次。
他们说如果你希望和特别的人在一起幸福
你在那棵树下，你的愿望一定会实现。

姬玛丽在这所学院寻找她命中注定的伴侣。

“这对我来说是一个非常重要的选择。
这一刻十年才会出现一次。
我想一起度过的人是……”

[来自官方网站]
